caption: The drawing consists of a large square divided into several irregular geometric sections, each filled with a different solid color, including yellow, blue, brown, red, green, orange, black, tan, and purple. Each section is bordered with decorative stitches, rendered in contrasting colors such as white, pink, green, orange, and blue. The uppermost segment is a yellow band overlaid with a geometric pattern of hexagons and dots in red, green, orange, and blue. The blue section contains a five-petaled yellow flower motif, and an orange section to its left has small yellow stitches arranged in a chevron pattern. Below, the tan section features two yellow butterflies with black outlines and decorative markings. On the purple segment in the lower right, a spray of yellow lines arranged in a fan shape is visible. The various colored segments are joined by zigzag, cross, and V-shaped sewing patterns in complementary thread colors, enhancing the patchwork effect. The overall drawing is framed by a plain, cream-colored background with some visible pencil marks and the letter "A" in the lower left corner.
title: Crazy Quilt (Section)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
